Thanks Marissa — useful recap. A few clarifications from procurement/legal side: 

- Procurement prefers PO for any committed spend. For trials we sometimes use a P-card (virtual card) to start immediately, but for enterprise deals we will submit a PO.
- Estimated procurement cycle for a standard SOW is 3-4 weeks once legal has final SOW. Our procurement contact (cc'd) can confirm exact SLA.
- Marketplace: Sarah and I both like the idea of an AWS Marketplace path. It speeds purchasing for some BU teams, but it doesn't replace the legal/PO process for enterprise billing in our ERP.

For our team to sign off on a PO, we need:
1) Final SOW (including data handling and retention clauses)
2) Pricing table and estimated monthly cost based on expected usage (your attachment is a good start)
3) Start date for billing — we prefer billing to start on an agreed date (e.g., trial start + 30 days or when trial acceptance criteria met).

We can do the Tue 9/1 10am PT sync. Procurement will prepare a template PO; legal will review the SOW and send redlines if needed.

John
Director, Platform Engineering | Acme Corp
